body: I hacked on this account KaptenMelle, but I didn't hack on MrMelle, my 2nd account! I got banned on MrMelle also when I didn't hack on it! Please unban me!!

title: I got banned on my 2nd account also??!?!?

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
You have decided to ban evade using MrMelle. Ban evasion is when you use another account to go around your other account's punishment. This is punishable and we do not tolerate this. Please consider making an appeal in 6-8 months.

Regards,
Hefayestus
